verdict.rationale: Airbyte's sync-schedules docs say each connection can choose one of three Schedule Types: Scheduled, Cron, or Manual. Cron mode runs syncs on a user-defined cron expression for precise timing. Sub-hour frequency is evidenced only by a '15-minute syncs' line on the pricing page, which suggests it is plan-gated. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the available sub-hour intervals and any plan restrictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scheduling behavior.
